entities.name: DMR1
observations: Arabidopsis homoserine kinase gene; named mutant alleles include dmr1-1 through dmr1-5 in the primary study.

entities.name: Fusarium culmorum infection
observations: Arabidopsis dmr1-2, dmr1-3, dmr1-4, and dmr1-5 showed increased silique resistance; dmr1-3 and dmr1-4 also showed reduced rosette-leaf colonization.

entities.name: Fusarium graminearum infection
observations: Arabidopsis dmr1-2 showed increased resistance in silique infection assays and reduced rosette-leaf colonization.

entities.name: PMID:25432266
observations: Brewer et al. 2014 directly tested Arabidopsis DMR1 mutant alleles against F. culmorum and F. graminearum.

entities.name: DMR1 enhanced Fusarium resistance
observations: The dmr1-2 allele enhanced resistance to both F. culmorum and F. graminearum, but resistance was allele- and tissue-dependent.

entities.name: DMR1 homoserine accumulation
observations: dmr1 siliques accumulated L-homoserine, undetectable in wild type; exogenous L-homoserine reduced bud infection, whereas D-homoserine did not.

entities.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
observations: Among the listed supplements, omega-3 fatty acids have the strongest cardiovascular-outcomes evidence, but benefit is formulation- and population-specific.

Ordinary EPA/DHA fish-oil supplementation is generally neutral in primary prevention; purified prescription EPA reduced ischemic events in selected high-risk statin-treated patients with elevated triglycerides.

entities.name: Severe hypercholesterolemia
observations: LDL cholesterol of 280 mg/dL meets severe primary hypercholesterolemia criteria and raises concern for familial hypercholesterolemia.
Guideline-directed treatment is high-intensity statin therapy without waiting for calculated 10-year risk; add ezetimibe and consider PCSK9-directed therapy if response is inadequate.

entities.name: Coenzyme Q10
observations: Coenzyme Q10 is not established for primary cardiovascular prevention or LDL lowering; it has been studied mainly for possible statin-associated muscle symptoms, with inconsistent randomized evidence.

entities.name: Omega-3 exam rationale
observations: Among the answer choices, omega-3 fatty acids are the likely exam answer because they have the most recognizable randomized cardiovascular-outcomes signal, especially for purified EPA.
Omega-3 supplementation does not replace aggressive pharmacologic LDL lowering in severe hypercholesterolemia.
